create_LiteLLMResponsesInteractionsStrea: create a LiteLLMResponsesInteractionsStreamingIterator to transform Responses API stream to Interactions API stream
transform_responses_chunk_to_interaction: transform a Responses API streaming chunk to an Interactions API streaming chunk
iterate_responses_stream_sync: iterate over a Responses API streaming iterator in sync mode and collect transformed Interactions API events
iterate_responses_stream_async: async iterate over a Responses API streaming iterator and collect transformed Interactions API events
collect_collected_text: collect accumulated text from Responses API delta events during streaming iteration
